test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the mother of B',

A - B means 'A is the brother of B',

A × B means 'A is the wife of B',

A ÷ B means 'A is the father of B'.

Based on the above, how is M related to P if 'M + N ÷ O × P - Q'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: M + N ÷ O × P - Q

It means: M is the Mother of N, N is the Father of O, O is the Wife of P, P is the Brother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ba5c01139a2abb06210dee2caf027a0bac96ded68f768be0fd4f34565300b63.png] 

So, M is the '**Wife's Father's Mother**' of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
